text:
sara_sales: Procurement returned the POC order form with three asks: PO before kickoff, net60, and W9. Legal also flagged a DPA carveout request (deletion-on-request). Need a quick position.

julia_revops: Can someone attach their marked PDF? Don't want to use email versions.

sara_sales: Uploaded to drive: /poc/acme/order_form_marked.pdf. They want DocuSign via their vendor portal and AP routing.

mike_legal: On DPA: deletion within 30 days and enumerated subprocessors. That's non-standard. Propose we provide current subprocessor list + notice window, and counter-propose 90 days for deletion of backups.

laura_security: They'll also ask for SOC2 and KMS residency (eu-west-1). We can offer Private deployment for KMS residency.

tim_engineer: Private POC is doable but adds cost. I'll draft a delta estimate for Private vs Hosted.

julia_revops: Finance won't like net60. Options to put forward: net45 for POC, or net60 + refundable hold. Which do we prefer?

sara_sales: Customer insists no hold. Ask: can we make an exception to net45 just for this POC?

mike_legal: I can accept net45 limited to the POC with late fee language. Will add DPA redline pushing back on 30-day deletion and enumerated subprocessors.

esign-bot: Envelope queued: env_9876. Routing: sourcing -> finance -> legal -> countersign@redwood.com. Preview: https://esign.redwood/env_9876

sara_sales: Plan: Mike will post redline (MSA + DPA + net45), Tim posts cost delta for Private, Julia confirms finance path. I'll then update procurement on DocuSign + net45.

-- end thread --
